name: social-os
description: Reference-first social-content operating system: competitor intelligence, breakout and trend topic research, guided scripts, storyboards and visual production, with an approval-gated video workflow.

interface.longDescription: Guided content workflow that studies reference/competitor channels first, researches 7–10 day trends and 30/60/90-day breakouts, builds packaging and retention-focused scripts, timed storyboards, consistent visual production packages and image QC, and never renders video without explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Start SocialOS and ask what I want to do.
Study my competitors and find breakout topics for my channel.
Create a new channel based on a reference channel.
